lines.text: Many learners say: The party will hold on Friday.
Better: The party will be held on Friday.
A party is held by people.
Be held! The meeting will be held at three.

data.wrong: The party will hold on Friday.
data.right: The party will be held on Friday.
data.why: A party is held by people.

native.tip: 中文说“聚会将举行”，不需要被动的标记。英语里活动是“被举行”的，要说 will be held。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “The party will hold on Friday.”😅 英语里活动是“被举行”的，要说 will be held：“The party will be held on Friday.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“The party will be held on Friday.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: The Chinese says "the party will be held" and does not require a passive marker. In English, an activity is "held". To say will be held.
en.caption: Do you say “The party will hold on Friday.” 😅 An event is held by people, so use be held: “The party will be held on Friday.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
